About.heading: Nexsetia, your digital growth partner
About.paragraph1: Nexsetia is a 360° digital agency born from the desire of a team of passionate professionals with complementary backgrounds to combine their expertise, creativity and analytical mindset to support businesses in their digital development.
About.paragraph2: Today, we work with businesses from a wide range of backgrounds, from young startups to well-established companies. Every project is different, as are the challenges that come with it.
About.paragraph3: Some of our clients come to us to design their entire digital strategy, while others are looking for a targeted boost, whether to optimize their organic search visibility (SEO), develop their digital communication, manage their Google Ads campaigns, strengthen their social media presence or rethink their marketing strategy.
About.paragraph4: Whatever stage your business is at, we integrate into your project to step in where we can make the greatest impact. Our goal is to implement the most suitable solutions to strengthen your digital footprint and maximize your visibility among your target audiences.
About.quote: We turn your ideas into tangible results.

baselineBuzz.title: When Vaseline Becomes Baseline: Anatomy of a Flawless Marketing Buzz
baselineBuzz.p1: We've all laughed at a mispronounced word. But seeing a global brand completely rebrand itself to join the joke is an entirely different story.
baselineBuzz.img1Alt: Baseline - Min Day Lee pronouncing Baseline with viral TikTok comments and reactions
baselineBuzz.img1Caption: Min Day Lee's viral TikTok video after pronouncing 'Baseline'.
baselineBuzz.p2: It all started with a video from South Korean creator Min Day Lee. While discussing her favorite skincare products, she pronounced 'Vaseline' as 'Baseline'. The 'v' sound doesn't natively exist in Korean, making this phonetic slip totally natural. On social media, community humor and algorithms did the rest, transforming the clip into a global meme.
baselineBuzz.img2Alt: Baseline - Compilation of TikTok creators recreating the Baseline meme
baselineBuzz.img2Caption: Creators worldwide show off the blue jar in viral video trends.
baselineBuzz.p3: Faced with this buzz, most corporate brands default to radio silence or stiff PR statements. Vaseline did the opposite: embracing self-deprecation and full community complicity.
baselineBuzz.img3Alt: Official Vaseline accounts rebranded to Baseline on social channels
baselineBuzz.img3Caption: From Vaseline US to international accounts, handles adopted the 'Baseline' branding.
baselineBuzz.p4: Official social handles temporarily changed their names and profile pictures to 'Baseline'. Shortly after, the brand playfully appointed Min Day Lee as the official 'CEO of Baseline'.
baselineBuzz.img4Alt: Baseline - Official statement naming Min Day Lee CEO of Baseline
baselineBuzz.img4Caption: The official statement appointing Min Day Lee CEO of Baseline.
baselineBuzz.p5: This is real-time newsjacking executed with perfect timing and authentic humanity.
baselineBuzz.p6: It proves the most iconic brands aren't afraid to step down from their pedestals and laugh with their audience.
baselineBuzz.p7: Authentic engagement is earned through agility, humor, and spontaneity.
baselineBuzz.faq1A: The art of reacting in real-time to viral trends or cultural moments to create authentic brand connection.
baselineBuzz.faq2Q: Why was Vaseline's reaction so successful?
baselineBuzz.faq2A: Rather than correcting the creator, they celebrated her, changed their branding, and fully leaned into the humor.
